confidence_notes: Restaurant meal and coffee anchors rest on aggregated estimates (CityCost, combien-coute.net, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere) and are medium quality. Beer comes from Yamu's Lion Index bar survey and an Expatistan pub point; its survey is undated, so it is medium-low. Cocktail and wine are weak: they rest on one or two venue or bottle price points, and the cocktail and wine glass are bounded from the beer price using typical local markups. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Colombo's hostel and hotel market. No booking pages or listings were inspected, and no accommodation search was run. Hotel and upscale-venue prices may exclude the 10% service charge and taxes. FX: the RBA observation is the 20 March 2026 USD value shown on the RBA exchange rates page in search results. I did not find a more recent RBA observation, so this value is about seven months older than the generation date and should be refreshed before use. I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Colombo-specific, with local-currency sources converted to USD by the model. Accommodation anchors are holistic Colombo estimates with no comparable city applied.
